lines.name: Host and attached capacity
lines.evidence: EC2/runtime host, EBS, load balancing, public IPv4 and recurring compute; reconcile all active regions/services. No complete current bill supplied.

lines.name: All generation and runtime charges
lines.evidence: Inference, AgentCore runtime, guardrails, SDK/model retries, failures, recovery, RAG fallback, Deep Review and stage checkpoints; measured monthly use and priced worst-case call ceiling absent.

lines.name: Knowledge Base and vector retrieval
lines.evidence: KB Retrieve queries, vector/index/search capacity and query requests; corpus volume, index service and actual charges unverified.

lines.name: Recurring corpus and source ingestion
lines.evidence: Parsing/OCR, embeddings, reindexing, repeated uploads and ingestion jobs; allocate recurring maintenance and amortization once. Workload unknown.

lines.name: All primary storage and requests
lines.evidence: S3 originals/extracts/derived objects, DSQL capacity/requests, object requests, retention and versions. Complete volumes and bill absent.

lines.name: Independent backup and restore operations
lines.evidence: Off-host copies, snapshots, retained versions, restore request/transfer and rehearsal allocation. Local disposable restore is not evidence of a funded independent backup service.

lines.name: Logs metrics traces alarms and retention
lines.evidence: CloudWatch and any other log/metric/trace sink, retention, ingestion and alarm charges; inspect enabled sinks and pricing tiers. No account evidence supplied.

lines.name: CDN requests egress and network capacity
lines.evidence: CloudFront/CDN requests, egress, NAT, inter-service/inter-region transfer, internet requests and any fixed network charges. Inspect actual topology and bill.

lines.name: Identity DNS domain support FX and taxes
lines.evidence: Cognito or other identity usage, DNS/domain amortization, certificates if charged, support, taxes and other services; record source-currency FX rate/date/tax basis. No complete bill/credit evidence supplied.
